sources.title: The parasitophorous vacuole membrane of Toxoplasma gondii: A custom ...
sources.snippet: Inside the PV, Toxoplasma relies on a crew of creative interior designers (the GRA proteins or GRA) to remodel and transform the space into an efficient living and breeding suite. Some GRA set up specialized delivery systems in the PVM (pores) to siphon off groceries (nutrients) from the host cytosol.
